entities.summary: Shilluk Kingdom, a political institution in South Sudan during Shilluk Kingdom and Pre-Colonial States (1490–1865). Grew from Shilluk Kingdom Founded and Dinka and Nuer Segmentary Societies. Led to the emergence of White Nile and Azande Kingdoms.
